title: InfiMed2: A Generalist Medical Multimodal Foundation Model from Contextual Evidence and Stability-Aware Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2609.34798v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent medical multimodal models have benefited from larger corpora, broader modality coverage, and stronger reasoning-oriented training, yet effective data design across continued pretraining (CPT) and post-training remains challenging. Medical sources vary substantially in structure, granularity, and information density, and their utility shifts as training progresses from broad knowledge acquisition to late-stage consolidation. Meanwhile, post-training is often dominated by short-form visual question answering, providing limited supervision for informative and answer-consistent explanations. translated_title: InfiMed2：基于上下文证据与稳定性感知监督的通用医学多模态基础模型
translated_abstract: 近期的医学多模态模型受益于更大的语料库、更广泛的模态覆盖以及更强的面向推理的训练，然而在持续预训练（CPT）和后训练阶段进行有效的数据设计仍然充满挑战。医学数据源在结构、粒度和信息密度上差异显著，并且随着训练从广泛的知识获取过渡到后期巩固阶段，其效用也在不断变化。与此同时，后训练阶段通常以短文本视觉问答为主，难以为信息丰富且答案一致的解释提供充分的监督。我们提出了InfiMed2，一个包含4B和27B参数的通用医学多模态基础模型系列，其核心创新是分阶段感知的数据设计。我们通过针对特定数据源的处理方式，构建了一个55.68B token的语料库，将广泛的临床知识与富含上下文的生物医学视觉证据相结合。我们的CPT流程首先适配视觉编码器，然后构建……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出InfiMed2系列通用医学多模态基础模型（4B/27B），通过分阶段感知的数据设计与55.68B token高质量语料库，解决了医学持续预训练与后训练中数据效用变化及解释性监督不足的难题。
en_tdlr: InfiMed2 is a family of 4B and 27B generalist medical multimodal foundation models built on stage-aware data design and a 55.68B-token curated corpus, addressing data utility shifts across CPT and post-training and the lack of informative, answer-consistent explanation supervision.
